resources.string: Mindful mode: watches only YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, to time how long you spend in YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok\'s feed and Facebook Reels, and to cover the feed with a break card at the limit you choose. It checks which screen of those apps is open, never what you watch, and nothing leaves your phone.

Shows a floating mic over your keyboard whenever you type in a text field, and types your dictation into that field. gillspeak reads only the focused text field and skips password fields. Speech is recognised on the phone and nothing leaves your phone.
